subject: Request: Open backfill requisition + interview gate checklist
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-20T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Request: open backfill for Sr Inference Engineer (replacement) - need interview gate approval

Team,

We need to open a backfill for the Senior Inference Engineer on Platform (headcount vacated May 1). This role is critical for the runtime reliability work slated for Q3 (KV-cache improvements + quantization profiling). Quick summary and asks: 

- Role: Senior Inference Engineer (replacement)
- Level: Senior / IC4 (target)
- Justification: continuity on production runtime, ownership of GPU kernel rollouts during wave 3 model migrations
- Budget band: $210k-$250k (total comp range; need finance confirmation)
- Timeline: post by 5/31, first interviews week of 6/7

Proposed interview panel:
- Hiring manager: Soojin Lee
- Tech lead: Jonas Weber
- System design: Marissa Cole
- Candidate experience / matchmaking: Aditya Rao

I attached an updated JD and a rough panel availability sheet. Can Marissa and Jonas confirm interview panel availability and level match? Laura — please confirm HR/comp band and whether we can proceed to the hiring gate (requisition creation + posting).

If everyone signs off, I want recruiting looped in today so they can start outreach to prior pipeline + TalentBridge. Also happy to greenlight a 2-week expedited timeline if recruiting can commit.

Thanks,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Sr. Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-20T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: open backfill for Sr Inference Engineer (replacement) - need interview gate approval

Soojin —

I'm supportive of opening the req. A couple of notes: 

- Level: IC4 as proposed sounds right given scope, but please add explicit expectations around on-call ownership in the JD (we need someone comfortable owning paged incidents).
- Compensation: finance asked we cap initial offer band at $245k total comp for now; exceptions require a documented business case.
- Panel: happy to own the system-design slot; I'll reserve 90 minutes for debriefs if needed.

Assuming Laura signs off on comp and recruiting confirms posting, I approve moving to the hiring gate.

Marissa

--

+1 from me. A couple logistical asks: 

- Please add Aditya as a required interviewer for system integration questions (he's got the most context on deployment infra).
- Candidate profile: prefer folks with 3+ years working on attention-heavy transformer inference in production.
- Panel availability: I'm free afternoons 6/8-6/12; attached the updated availability sheet with blocked times.

If TalentBridge has strong candidates I can carve earlier blocks.

Jonas

Thanks team — HR/TA side: 

- Compensation: confirmed we can post with a $210k-$245k band. If you think we need to go to $250k+, I need a compensation escalation form signed by Marissa.
- Posting & req: I can create the REQ-2027-098 today once Soojin confirms final JD (attached).
- Attachments: JD_Senior_Inference_Engineer_v2.pdf, interview_panel_availability.xlsx (contains suggested slots and recruiter notes).

Next steps I need from you: final JD approval and a designated recruiter contact. If you want TalentBridge to run an initial slate, confirm and I'll add their contact into the req notes.

Laura

Subject: TalentBridge: candidate availability and initial slate for Sr Inference Engineer

Hi Soojin/Laura —

Thanks for sharing the JD. TalentBridge can push an initial slate tomorrow. Two quick items from our side: 

1) Candidate Carlos Ruiz (direct intro below) is available for an initial screen Mon 6/7 10:00am PT or Tue 6/8 2:30pm PT. He has 5 years production inference experience (quantization + batching) and is currently at a comp of $235k TC. He is open to Redwood band.
2) We need confirmation on the interview format (60 min panel all in one vs. split: screen + onsite technical loop). Panel length impacts scheduling complexity.

If you want us to proceed with Carlos as a priority, confirm the slot and interview format and we'll lock it. Happy to send 2–3 more CVs later today.

Best,
Elise

--

Senior Recruiter, TalentBridge

Quick update and greenlight: 

- Marissa approved the role and will sign the comp escalation if needed; Laura confirmed posting band $210k-$245k.
- Jonas and Aditya are on the panel and available the week of 6/7 (see attached availability).
- Format: let's do an initial 30-minute recruiter screen, then a 90-minute technical loop (split into system design + runtime coding exercise). That keeps candidate load reasonable and gives us time for a focused debrief.
- Elise: please lock Carlos for Mon 6/7 10:00am PT for a 30-minute recruiter screen; if he clears, we'll schedule the technical loop for 6/9 afternoon. Please send CV and any red flags to Laura and me prior to the screen.

Proceeding to hiring gate: Laura, please create the req and loop TA. Recruiting: start outreach and prioritize internal backfill pipeline first.

Thanks all — moving to recruiting.

Soojin
